mainEntity.name: How do I get a copy of your SOC 2 report or ISO certificate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the request buttons in the Overview tab above or email us. SOC 2 reports are shared under NDA; ISO certificates can be shared directly.
Customer data is stored in our primary cloud region. Regional hosting options are available on enterprise plans - contact us for details.

mainEntity.name: Do you sign Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our standard DPA incorporates the EU Standard Contractual Clauses and is available to all customers on request.

mainEntity.name: How do I report a security vulnerability?

acceptedAnswer.text: Email our security team at the address below. We acknowledge reports within 2 business days and keep you informed through remediation.
